detail: The BCEAO's own financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 state in note 4.2 that Cabinet Deloitte Côte d'Ivoire was designated Commissaire Contrôleur, covering the verification of the accounts for 2024 to 2029; the statements are signed at Abidjan on 25 February 2025. The notice covers the centralised accounts of the BCEAO, not the separate audits of its national directorates.
source_title: Etats financiers de la BCEAO, exercice clos le 31 decembre 2024 (BCEAO)
